PTree.Interp.FoldITree.itree_fold_observe
endpoints.type:
@FoldITree.itree_fold_observe
     : forall (E MN F : Type -> Type) (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN A),
       @Eqit.eq_itree F A A (@eq A)
         (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A t)
         match @PTreeDefinition.observe E MN A t with
         | @PTreeDefinition.RetF _ _ _ _ a =>
             {|
               ITreeDefinition._observe := @ITreeDefinition.RetF F A (ITreeDefinition.itree F A) a
             |}
         | @PTreeDefinition.TauF _ _ _ _ u =>
             {|
               ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                 @ITreeDefinition.TauF F A (ITreeDefinition.itree F A)
                   (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
                      (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A u)
             |}
         | @PTreeDefinition.VisF _ _ _ _ X e k =>
             @ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F X A (handle X e)
               (fun x : X =>
                {|
                  ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                    @ITreeDefinition.TauF F A (ITreeDefinition.itree F A)
                      (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
                         (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A
                         (k x))
                |})
         | @PTreeDefinition.ProbF _ _ _ _ X mu k =>
             @ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F X A (sample X mu)
               (fun x : X =>
                {|
                  ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                    @ITreeDefinition.TauF F A (ITreeDefinition.itree F A)
                      (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
                         (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A
                         (k x))
                |})
         end

         (A B : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN A) (k : A -> PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN B),

         (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample B
            (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.bind E MN A B t k))

            (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
               (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A t)
            (fun a : A =>
             @Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
               (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample B (k a)))

PTree.Interp.ReaderFoldITree.itree_reader_fold_observe
endpoints.type:
@ReaderFoldITree.itree_reader_fold_observe
     : forall (Env : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type)
         (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Reader.readerE Env) E) MN A)
         (env : Env),
       @Eqit.eq_itree F A A (@eq A)
         (@ReaderFold.fold_reader Env E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A t
            env)
         match @PTreeDefinition.observe (Sum.sum1 (Reader.readerE Env) E) MN A t with
         | @PTreeDefinition.RetF _ _ _ _ a =>
             {|
               ITreeDefinition._observe := @ITreeDefinition.RetF F A (ITreeDefinition.itree F A) a
             |}
         | @PTreeDefinition.TauF _ _ _ _ u =>
             {|
               ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                 @ITreeDefinition.TauF F A (ITreeDefinition.itree F A)
                   (@ReaderFold.fold_reader Env E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
                      (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle
                      sample A u env)
             |}
         | @PTreeDefinition.VisF _ _ _ _ X (@Sum.inl1 _ _ _ re) k =>
             match
               re in (Reader.readerE _ X0)
               return
                 ((X0 -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Reader.readerE Env) E) MN A) ->
                  ITreeDefinition.itree F A)
             with
             | @Reader.Ask _ =>
                 fun k0 : Env -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Reader.readerE Env) E) MN A =>
                 {|
                   ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                     @ITreeDefinition.TauF F A (ITreeDefinition.itree F A)
                       (@ReaderFold.fold_reader Env E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
                          (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F)
                          handle sample A (k0 env) env)
                 |}
             end k
         | @PTreeDefinition.VisF _ _ _ _ X (@Sum.inr1 _ _ _ fe) k =>
             @ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F X A (handle X fe)
               (fun x : X =>
                {|
                  ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                    @ITreeDefinition.TauF F A (ITreeDefinition.itree F A)
                      (@ReaderFold.fold_reader Env E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
                         (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F)
                         handle sample A (k x) env)
                |})
         | @PTreeDefinition.ProbF _ _ _ _ X mu k =>
             @ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F X A (sample X mu)
               (fun x : X =>
                {|
                  ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                    @ITreeDefinition.TauF F A (ITreeDefinition.itree F A)
                      (@ReaderFold.fold_reader Env E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
                         (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F)
                         handle sample A (k x) env)
                |})
         end

            env)

endpoints.name: PTree.Interp.ReaderFoldITree.itree_reader_fold_bind
endpoints.type:
@ReaderFoldITree.itree_reader_fold_bind
     : forall (Env : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type)
         (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A B : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Reader.readerE Env) E) MN A)
         (k : A -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Reader.readerE Env) E) MN B)
         (env : Env),
       @Eqit.eq_itree F B B (@eq B)
         (@ReaderFold.fold_reader Env E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample B
            (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.bind (Sum.sum1 (Reader.readerE Env) E) MN A B t k) env)
         (@ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F A B
            (@ReaderFold.fold_reader Env E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
               (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample
               A t env)
            (fun a : A =>
             @ReaderFold.fold_reader Env E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F)
               (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample
               B (k a) env))

endpoints.name: PTree.Interp.WriterFoldITree.itree_state_bind_ret
endpoints.type:
@WriterFoldITree.itree_state_bind_ret
     : forall (W : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type)
         (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (X A : Type) (x : X) (k : X -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE W) E) MN A)
         (log : W),
       @Eqit.eq_itree F (W * A) (W * A) (@eq (W * A))
         (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample (W * A)
            (@State.run_state W E MN A
               (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.bind (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE W) E) MN X A
                  {|
                    PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                      @PTreeDefinition.RetF (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE W) E) MN X
                        (PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE W) E) MN X) x
                  |} k) log))
         (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample (W * A)
            (@State.run_state W E MN A (k x) log))

endpoints.name: PTree.Interp.WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_fold_observe
endpoints.type:
@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_fold_observe
     : forall (W : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type) (op : Monoid.Monoid W),
       @Monoid.MonoidLaws W op ->
       forall (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN A)
         (log : W),
       @Eqit.eq_itree F (W * A) (W * A) (@eq (W * A))
         (@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_from W E MN F op handle sample A t log)
         match @PTreeDefinition.observe (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN A t with
         | @PTreeDefinition.RetF _ _ _ _ a =>
             {|
               ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                 @ITreeDefinition.RetF F (W * A) (ITreeDefinition.itree F (W * A)) (log, a)
             |}
         | @PTreeDefinition.TauF _ _ _ _ u =>
             {|
               ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                 @ITreeDefinition.TauF F (W * A) (ITreeDefinition.itree F (W * A))
                   (@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_from W E MN F op handle sample A u log)
             |}
         | @PTreeDefinition.VisF _ _ _ _ X (@Sum.inl1 _ _ _ we) k =>
             match
               we in (Writer.writerE _ X0)
               return
                 ((X0 -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN A) ->
                  ITreeDefinition.itree F (W * A))
             with
             | @Writer.Tell _ w =>
                 fun k0 : unit -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN A =>
                 {|
                   ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                     @ITreeDefinition.TauF F (W * A) (ITreeDefinition.itree F (W * A))
                       (@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_from W E MN F op handle sample A
                          (k0 tt) (@Monoid.monoid_plus W op log w))
                 |}
             end k
         | @PTreeDefinition.VisF _ _ _ _ X (@Sum.inr1 _ _ _ fe) k =>
             @ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F X (W * A) (handle X fe)
               (fun x : X =>
                {|
                  ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                    @ITreeDefinition.TauF F (W * A) (ITreeDefinition.itree F (W * A))
                      (@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_from W E MN F op handle sample A (k x) log)
                |})
         | @PTreeDefinition.ProbF _ _ _ _ X mu k =>
             @ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F X (W * A) (sample X mu)
               (fun x : X =>
                {|
                  ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                    @ITreeDefinition.TauF F (W * A) (ITreeDefinition.itree F (W * A))
                      (@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_from W E MN F op handle sample A (k x) log)
                |})
         end

endpoints.name: PTree.Interp.WriterFoldITree.itree_fold_run_writer_from
endpoints.type:
@WriterFoldITree.itree_fold_run_writer_from
     : forall (W : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type) (op : Monoid.Monoid W),
       @Monoid.MonoidLaws W op ->
       forall (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN A)
         (log : W),
       @Eqit.eutt F (W * A) (W * A) (@eq (W * A))
         (@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_from W E MN F op handle sample A t log)
         (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample (W * A)
            (@State.run_state W E MN A
               (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.interp (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E)
                  (Sum.sum1 (State.stateE W) E) MN (@Writer.writer_handler W E MN op) A t) log))

endpoints.name: PTree.Interp.WriterFoldITree.itree_fold_run_writer
endpoints.type:
@WriterFoldITree.itree_fold_run_writer
     : forall (W : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type) (op : Monoid.Monoid W),
       @Monoid.MonoidLaws W op ->
       forall (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)

            (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample A t)
         (@Fold.fold E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F)
            (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample (W * A)
            (@Writer.run_writer W E MN A op t))

endpoints.name: PTree.Interp.WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_prefix
endpoints.type:
@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_prefix
     : forall (W : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type) (op : Monoid.Monoid W),
       @Monoid.MonoidLaws W op ->
       forall (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN A)
         (prefix log : W),
       @Eqit.eq_itree F (W * A) (W * A) (@eq (W * A))
         (@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_from W E MN F op handle sample A t
            (@Monoid.monoid_plus W op prefix log))
         (@ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F (W * A) (W * A)
            (@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_from W E MN F op handle sample A t log)
            (fun wa : W * A =>
             {|
               ITreeDefinition._observe :=
                 @ITreeDefinition.RetF F (W * A) (ITreeDefinition.itree F (W * A))
                   (@Monoid.monoid_plus W op prefix (@fst W A wa), @snd W A wa)
             |}))

endpoints.name: PTree.Interp.WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_bind_from
endpoints.type:
@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_bind_from
     : forall (W : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type) (op : Monoid.Monoid W),
       @Monoid.MonoidLaws W op ->
       forall (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A B : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN A)
         (k : A -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN B)
         (log : W),
       @Eqit.eq_itree F (W * B) (W * B) (@eq (W * B))
         (@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_from W E MN F op handle sample B
            (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.bind (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN A B t k) log)
         (@ITreeDefinition.ITree.bind F (W * A) (W * B)
            (@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_from W E MN F op handle sample A t log)
            (fun wa : W * A =>
             @WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_from W E MN F op handle sample B
               (k (@snd W A wa)) (@fst W A wa)))

@WriterFoldITree.itree_writer_fold_bind
     : forall (W : Type) (E MN F : Type -> Type) (op : Monoid.Monoid W),
       @Monoid.MonoidLaws W op ->
       forall (handle : forall X : Type, E X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (sample : forall X : Type, MN X -> ITreeDefinition.itree F X)
         (A B : Type) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN A)
         (k : A -> PTreeDefinition.ptree (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN B),
       @Eqit.eq_itree F (W * B) (W * B) (@eq (W * B))
         (@WriterFold.fold_writer W E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) op
            (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample B
            (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.bind (Sum.sum1 (Writer.writerE W) E) MN A B t k))
         (@Monad.bind (Basics.Monads.writerT W (ITreeDefinition.itree F))
            (@WriterT.writerT_monad W (ITreeDefinition.itree F) op (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F))
            A B
            (@WriterFold.fold_writer W E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) op
               (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample
               A t)
            (fun a : A =>
             @WriterFold.fold_writer W E MN (ITreeDefinition.itree F) op
               (@ITreeDefinition.Monad_itree F) (@ITreeDefinition.MonadIter_itree F) handle sample
               B (k a)))
